newsitem.title: UK: Summary of main UK budget measures.
newsitem.headline: Summary of main UK budget measures.

text.p: Following is the Treasury's summary of the main 1997/98 budget measures announced by Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke:
Lasting prosperity - combining sustained economic growth with low inflation so that living standards go on rising year after year.
Helping people keep more of what they earn:
- basic rate of income tax reduced to 23p
- 20p income tax band widened by 200 stg
- income tax personal allowances further increased
- inheritance tax threshold increased by 15,000 stg
- spending more on the services people care most about
- maintaining firm control of public spending
- reinforcing the downward path of borrowing Protecting the ordinary taxpayer:
- boosting the fight against tax and social security fraud
- phasing out special reliefs and allowances.
